title: Proper direct image has a right adjoint on $D^b_{ctf}$
statement:
Since $Rp_!=Rp_*$ as functors $\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))\to\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\Lambda))$ for proper $p$,
[sk-thm-existence] gives in particular:

For proper $p\colon X\to Y$ and admissible $\Lambda$, the functor
$Rp_*\colon\Dctf(X,\Lambda)\to\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$ has a right adjoint $p^!$.

steps.text:
For proper $p$ the identity is an admissible compactification, so $Rp_!=Rp_*$ on
$\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))$, and parts (3) and (4) of [sk-thm-existence] give the right
adjoint $p^!$ on $\Dctf$. Details: [det-cor-existence-ii-restriction]. For the three
$\ell$-adic rings the same conclusion is stated, with a proof by reduction to torsion
levels, in [lem-sfb-dc-proper-pushforward-left-adjoint-e],
[lem-sfb-dc-proper-pushforward-left-adjoint-oe] and
[lem-sfb-dc-proper-pushforward-left-adjoint-qlbar].
